gloss: agricultural off-season; slack season in farming

definitions.gloss: agricultural off-season; slack season in farming
definitions.explanation: The period of the year when there is little agricultural work to be done, typically winter in Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{農閑期|のうかんき}だ。
{農閑期|のうかんき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦アルバイト→アルバイト：01528_arubaito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{農家|のうか}→農家：03539_nouka⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Many farmers take on part-time jobs during the off-season.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{農閑期|のうかんき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{祭|まつ}り→祭り：03735_matsuri⟧や⟦{行事|ぎょうじ}→行事：00078_gyouji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われる→行う：01238_okonau⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}かった→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: In old Japan, festivals and events were often held during the agricultural off-season.

notes:
A compound of {農|のう} (agriculture), {閑|かん} (leisure, quiet), and {期|き} (period). In Japanese rice-farming culture, the {農閑期|のうかんき} (roughly November through March) was historically a time for festivals, craft production, construction work, and community activities.

The opposite term is ⟦{農繁期|のうはんき}→農繁期：27247_nouhanki⟧ (busy farming season), when planting, tending, and harvesting demand intensive labor.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {農閑期|のうかんき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to enter the farming off-season
- {農閑期|のうかんき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧: off-season work
- {農閑期|のうかんき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{利用|りよう}する→利用する：21735_riyousuru⟧: to make use of the farming off-season

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{農繁期|のうはんき}→農繁期：27247_nouhanki⟧: busy farming season — the antonym, when agricultural work is intense
- ⟦{閑散期|かんさんき}→閑散期：08367_kansanki⟧: slow season, off-peak period — broader term applying to any industry
- ⟦オフ→オフ：10733_ofu⟧⟦シーズン→シーズン：10944_shiizun⟧: off-season — the loanword, used more broadly for tourism, sports, etc.
